title: Macroscopic Scalar Curvature in High Dimensions
summary: We describe a version of positive macroscopic scalar curvature motivated by the work of Alpert, Balitskiy, and Guth, and prove that this condition on a manifold implies a bound on its 1-width in terms of its first Betti number. A key tool in the proof is a decomposition of any closed manifold into a family of chains with convenient combinatorial structure, which was inspired by Nabutovsky, Rotman, and Sabourau's work on sweepouts.
